scope: Exact runner/source review, synthetic failure/scoring controls, and independent revalidation of the already-built small real preflight; no real compilation or scored timing in this review
static_findings: Schema/2 freezes explicit boolean query_cache and closed_executable in the plan and summary. Load rejects older schema/runner identity. Query-cache cannot be combined with the compiler-cache-cold profile.

Only ZIL command construction receives the new flags. Rust native CGU options and existing target/overflow/panic/bitcode flags retain their previous behavior. Cache roots are within each fresh sequence work directory.
Actual compiler JSON is read at build and reread from hashed raw stdout during summary validation; row pass=true or an edited copied report alone cannot override requested mode checks.

Requested query mode requires cold/private/public miss plus successful store, unchanged hit without store, no fallback/write-failure reason, a valid key and nonnegative integer CT work records. Disabled-mode compatibility permits old reports without the new fields.

Closed mode requires the actual reported boolean and an explicit nonnegative integer changed-definition count; ignored/absent mode, absent count and malformed count are rejected. Zero changed definitions is valid for a conservative cross-unit graph.

Existing Verify-count and timings checks, source snapshots, full oracle checks, plan/record/log/executable hashes and completion coverage remain in the scoring path. Complete successful preflight remains mandatory for build and runtime scoring.
Tool invocation aliases, resolved paths/symlink targets, candidate linker resolution and extra dependency identities retain the previous frozen-identity logic; this extension does not weaken it.

independent_controls.method: Both actual compiler and native execution are mocked. For invalid reports the outer raw-log, records and completion hashes are deliberately kept consistent, forcing the score refusal to inspect report semantics. Every refusal omits wall/cpu/bootstrap score fields.

includes: flip query-cache mode against prior raw preflight
flip closed-executable mode against prior raw preflight
independent_identity_controls.method: Only private copies of the frozen plan are changed; original source/binary/log artifacts remain unchanged.

real_preflight.scope: tree4x2 only, O0 incremental, query_cache=true, closed_executable=false, requested8CGU/2jobs

reviewer_harness_attempts.reason: common.save uses exclusive creation; the review fixture already created its plan file. Corrected only the independent review script to replace its own synthetic plan/receipt.

limitations: Real smoke covers one small corpus and query mode; closed=true report/gate combinations are synthetic here. The backend and driver/CLI require their separate source/native reviews and final combined real preflight.
No claim that the small preflight establishes speed, runtime quality, five-corpus completion or a product gate.
Binary bytes and declared source commit are frozen and checked; this review does not independently rebuild the binary to prove the source-to-binary declaration.
The source unchanged assertion covers the exact reviewed runner and control file, even though the author worktree subsequently integrated unrelated backend/CLI commits.
